en-US.author: Zed Industries, Inc.
en-US.description: A multiplayer environment for coding with teammates and agents.
en-US.longDescription:
Delta brings teammates and coding agents into one shared thread. Your conversations and code live in the same place, and every change is anchored to the reasoning behind it, so the decisions and prompts that produced the code stay readable alongside the results.
Work in the Delta app or from your terminal; DeltaDB keeps both in the same thread. The version control system records every edit with the conversation behind it, and a thread shared from Claude Code can be joined from the Delta app, and the other way around.
Invite teammates into the same thread to review, comment, and work alongside the agent in real time. Comment on the conversation or any line of code, and the feedback stays anchored as the work evolves.
en-US.name: Delta
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ New this release
- Threads can now run on Claude Agent: set it up during onboarding, or turn it on under Agent Connections in Settings → LLM Providers. Signing in to Claude Agent closes the sign-in panel automatically.
- Delta Web can now create new threads, from the New Thread button in the sidebar or the phone thread menu.
- Save passages in a thread with Highlight Selection and attach optional shared notes to revisit later.
- Desktop keyboard shortcuts can now be customized in Settings > Keymap or by asking the agent.
- You can now sign in to GitHub Enterprise Cloud Copilot accounts by setting Enterprise URL under GitHub Copilot Chat in LLM Providers settings.
- delta worktree diff <worktree> --merge <source> shows what delta worktree merge would change, so you and the agent can review any worktree fork before merging it.
- Open Claude’s personal configuration folder from the Agent Options menu or Settings → LLM Providers → Claude Configuration to add skills and edit Claude settings.
- You can now ask Delta on desktop to hide or restore models in your model picker.
⚡ Better than before
- Onboarding now lets you choose a model provider up front or connect one later from the welcome thread.
- Subthread checkouts, including ones you created, are now removed after an hour without use to free disk space; reopening the subthread restores its files, except ignored ones such as build output.
- Cursor After Send now defaults to Next User Message, leaving you ready to write your next message after sending.
- The sidebar’s new-thread button now lets you choose a visible project when grouping by state or time, or browsing History.
- Returning to the organization Overview now shows your previous thread list immediately while checking for updates in the background.
🔧 Fixes and reliability
- Delta no longer crashes when you confirm an @ mention or slash command while a collaborator is typing earlier in the thread.
- Threads sorted by Last Prompted no longer move up your sidebar when someone else sends a prompt.
- Turning off Font Ligatures now also removes ligatures from inline code in comments.
- The model selector’s tooltip now shows keyboard shortcuts even when another pane has keyboard focus.

zh-CN.description: 与队友和编程智能体一起开发代码的多端协作环境。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Delta 把队友和编程智能体放进同一条共享会话里。对话与代码存在一起，每一处改动都锚定在它背后的思路上，因此产出这些代码的决策与提示词能和结果一起被回看。
可以在 Delta 应用里工作，也可以在终端里工作；DeltaDB 让两边落在同一条会话中。版本控制系统会把每次编辑连同它背后的对话一起记录下来，从 Claude Code 分享出去的会话可以在 Delta 应用里加入，反过来也一样。
邀请队友进入同一条会话，即可实时评审、评论，并与智能体协同工作。可以针对对话或任意一行代码留言，随着工作推进，评论始终锚在原来的位置。
